purpose: Bounded diagnosis of native synchronous filesystem requests during measured Codex/SQLite startup, including before native carrier placement.

notes: The earlier outage retained one native synchronous broker request at stage=hull, with no placed Codex native jobs and no async-FS backlog. This does not identify the blocking layer.
G proves the diagnostic observer can emit terminal counter summaries before/without carrier-dependent output. It does not reproduce or fix the fifth-launch outage.
Later G/H/I/J/K trial comparisons and their runtime outcomes belong to the separate live-capture evidence; this document does not aggregate them.
Host build CPU affinity and sampled monotonic ages do not measure guest CPU execution time.
Missing, expired, skipped or released observations alone do not establish I/O completion.

implementation.selection: Measured launch Trace: codex/codex-check and sqlite names, actual VM incarnation plus unique launch request; other applications are unarmed.

bounds.clock_when: arm once per selected measured launch, admitted nonfull selected attempts, active ticket phase changes, observer while armed/pending or new counters

phase.2: service: may be waiting stream turn or owner state

counters: full: selected attempts rejected by 16-slot bound
expired: observations discarded at deadline, not disk operations
released: observation owner dropped; this alone does not prove disk completion

race_protocol: Unique monotonically assigned launch-budget epoch prevents stale admission consuming a rearmed window. VM generation captured from launch context and rechecked from live VM atomic on admission.
Writer claims exact request ID to RESERVED before any slot field stores; expiry cannot reuse while reserved. Stale ticket after expiration/reuse cannot mutate or clear replacement.

Writer release fence after odd version pairs with reader acquire fence even when a relaxed field read observes a concurrent write; final version/id recheck skips it. Every field is atomic and reads never spin.
Expiration only clears numeric observation slots. It never mutates broker queue, filesystem futures, completion contents, owner requests, device state, or cancellation policy.
implementation.instrumentation_cost: Admission clock/atomics run under the existing request queue lock; retired write abort admission also has the existing owner registry lock. This is bounded selected-request instrumentation overhead, not a free observation.
limitations: This is diagnostics, not a demonstrated fix for the outage.
Five-second sampling can miss completed phase transitions; concurrent snapshots can skip rows.
After 180 seconds a pending operation is intentionally unobserved, not canceled or marked complete.
After the 128-attempt budget is spent, later operations are intentionally untracked. Full/missed/expired/released counters qualify missing rows.
BSP starvation can prevent the observer itself from running; absent records cannot prove that no request is pending.
Host-extracted production hooks validate diagnostic integration, not TRUEOS kernel/device behavior; an actual kernel source check/build is still required.

A publisher suspended while holding RESERVED is never reclaimed or reused until it resumes; that slot may remain unavailable, but RESERVED alone cannot keep observer clock reads active beyond the armed window.

source_snapshots.source_snapshot:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read a bounded capture window; export only fixed native-FS numeric fields.

Use one boot per window: numeric launch/request IDs are scoped to a kernel boot.
Missing/expired observations never establish request completion.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re

ROW_KEYS = frozenset(('vm','generation','launch','request','op','phase','status','queued_ms','service_ms','phase_ms','age_ms','full','missed','expired','released'))
COUNTER_KEYS = ('full','missed','expired','released')
SUMMARY_KEYS = frozenset(COUNTER_KEYS)
MARKER = re.compile(rb'\bcodex-fs-native(?P<summary>-summary)?\b(?P<fields>[^\n]*)')
FIELDS = re.compile(rb'(?:[ \t]+[a-z_]+=[0-9]+)+[ \t\r]*\Z')
ANSI = re.compile(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]')
MAX_LINE = 65_536
U64_MAX = (1 << 64)-1
PHASES = {1:'queued',2:'service',3:'filesystem',4:'result',5:'publish',6:'published',7:'retire',8:'finished'}
OPS = {1:'prepare-volatile-files',2:'read-file',3:'read-file-len',4:'read-file-range',5:'stat',6:'typed-stat',7:'write-file-begin',8:'write-file-begin-typed',9:'create-dir-all',10:'write-file-chunk',11:'write-file-finish',12:'write-file-abort',13:'html-tree',14:'json-all',15:'list-dir',16:'typed-list-dir',17:'remove',18:'exists'}


def parse_line(line):
    match = MARKER.search(ANSI.sub(b'', line))
    if match is None:
        return None
    tail = match['fields']
    if FIELDS.fullmatch(tail) is None:
        return False
    pairs = [token.split(b'=', 1) for token in tail.split()]
    if len(pairs) != len({key for key, _ in pairs}):
        return False
    try:
        fields = {key.decode('ascii'):int(value) for key, value in pairs}
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
        return False
    expected = SUMMARY_KEYS if match['summary'] else ROW_KEYS
    if fields.keys() != expected or any(value > U64_MAX for value in fields.values()):
        return False
    if not match['summary'] and not (fields['vm'] < 64 and fields['launch'] > 0
            and 0 < fields['request'] < U64_MAX and fields['op'] in OPS
            and fields['phase'] in PHASES and fields['status'] <= 3):
        return False
    return {'summary':bool(match['summary']),'fields':fields}


def read_window(stream, start, end, snapshot_size):
    if start < 0 or end < start or end > snapshot_size:
        raise ValueError('invalid byte window')
    stream.seek(start)
    remaining = end-start
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    buffer = b''
    discard = False
    offset = start
    line_offset = start
    rows = []
    summaries = []
    malformed = 0
    oversized = 0
    def accept(line, at):
        nonlocal malformed
        parsed = parse_line(line)
        if parsed is False:
            malformed += 1
        elif parsed is not None:
            fields = {'offset':at, **parsed['fields']}
            (summaries if parsed['summary'] else rows).append(fields)
    while remaining:
        chunk = stream.read(min(65_536, remaining))
        if not chunk:
            raise ValueError('capture shrank during snapshot read')
        digest.update(chunk)
        remaining -= len(chunk)
        for piece in chunk.splitlines(keepends=True):
            ended = piece.endswith(b'\n') or piece.endswith(b'\r')
            if not discard:
                if len(buffer)+len(piece) > MAX_LINE:
                    buffer = b''
                    discard = True
                    oversized += 1
                else:
                    buffer += piece
            offset += len(piece)
            if ended:
                if not discard:
                    accept(buffer, line_offset)
                buffer = b''
                discard = False
                line_offset = offset
    if buffer and not discard:
        accept(buffer, line_offset)
    groups = {}
    for row in rows:
        key = tuple(row[name] for name in ('vm','generation','launch','request'))
        group = groups.setdefault(key, {'vm':key[0],'generation':key[1],'launch':key[2],
            'request':key[3],'op':row['op'],'op_name':OPS[row['op']], 'observations':[],
            'max_age_ms':0,'max_queued_ms':0,'max_service_ms':0,'max_phase_ms':0})
        group['observations'].append(row)
        for metric in ('age_ms','queued_ms','service_ms','phase_ms'):
            group['max_'+metric] = max(group['max_'+metric],row[metric])
        group['last_phase'] = row['phase']
        group['last_phase_name'] = PHASES[row['phase']]
        group['last_status'] = row['status']
    ordered = sorted(rows+summaries,key=lambda row:row['offset'])
    first = {key:ordered[0][key] for key in COUNTER_KEYS} if ordered else None
    last = {key:ordered[-1][key] for key in COUNTER_KEYS} if ordered else None
    decreased = any(later[key]<earlier[key] for earlier,later in zip(ordered,ordered[1:]) for key in COUNTER_KEYS)
    delta = {key:last[key]-first[key] for key in COUNTER_KEYS} if ordered and not decreased else None
    return {'schema':1,'capture_window':{'start_offset':start,'end_offset':end,
        'snapshot_size':snapshot_size,'bytes':end-start,'sha256':digest.hexdigest()},
        'rows':rows,'summaries':summaries,'requests':list(groups.values()),
        'counter_first':first,'counter_last':last,'counter_delta':delta,
        'counter_decrease_detected':decreased,'malformed_marker_lines':malformed,
        'oversized_lines_skipped':oversized,
        'qualifiers':['Use one boot per byte window; IDs can repeat after reboot.',
            'At most 16 pending observations, 128 selected attempts per measured launch, 180-second deadline and four records per five-second tick.',
            'Full/missed counters qualify incomplete coverage; expiration removes observation only and never cancels disk work.',
            'Released counts dropped observation owners; absence or a release count alone never proves disk completion.',
            'Rows are sampled snapshots; brief phases may be missed and BSP starvation may suppress samples.']}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('capture')
    parser.add_argument('--start-offset',type=int,default=0)
    parser.add_argument('--end-offset',type=int)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        with open(args.capture,'rb') as stream:
            size = os.fstat(stream.fileno()).st_size
            report = read_window(stream,args.start_offset,args.end_offset if args.end_offset is not None else size,size)
    except (OSError,ValueError):
        parser.exit(2,'cannot read the requested capture byte window\n')
    print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

portable_tools.capture_replay: The parser snapshots file size, reads only the selected byte range, hashes all selected bytes, skips oversized lines, and exports only exact fixed numeric native-FS fields. Use one kernel boot per window because numeric IDs repeat after reboot.
portable_tools.source_snapshot_phase: Exact promoted files after private validation; original promotion identities are recorded in tests.promotion_tests.
